SELECT id, login_name, user_name, description_code, description_param, operation_state, operation_action, ip, create_time AS operationTime FROM bp_login_log WHERE is_deleted = 0
and login_name like concat('%',#{loginName},'%')
and user_name like concat('%',#{userName},'%')
and create_time between #{startTimeDate} and #{endTimeDate}
order by create_time desc,operation_action desc

SELECT id, login_name, user_name, description_code, description_param, operation_state, operation_action, ip, create_time from bp_login_log WHERE is_deleted = 0
and login_name like concat('%',#{loginName},'%')
and user_name like concat('%',#{userName},'%')
and create_time between concat(#{startTime}, ' 00:00:00') and concat(#{endTime}, ' 23:59:59')
order by create_time desc
